reserves.label: RYO Burn Reserve

No residual transfer: the 1,930,064.65 RYO left in 5wVB… is the Burn Reserve's opening balance (owner decision).
treasuryMigration.purpose: Relocation of the Treasury holdings from the former Squads Treasury vault (now the RYO Burn Reserve) to the Treasury GPbg… (owner decision 2026-11-12: GPbg… is the Treasury until the owner asks for a change). Only this leg can be recorded as a Treasury relocation; recording ends when the migration is completed and reconciled (status completed). Relocations are never revenue and never burns. A later move needs its own reviewed migration entry.
